scope: Only Jeddah pit fascia artwork/shading and separator lettering; existing lane/apron/fixture geometry stays fixed.
fascia_observations: Candidate14 had tiny generic DHL text and excessive saturated yellow. Direct forward source shows a broad slanted red wordmark with flanking speed stripes on a muted yellow fascia.
artwork: Original DejaVuSans-based typesetting, horizontally stretched/slanted with separately drawn speed stripes. No source-game pixels shipped. Jeddah private generated PanelDHL background blue channel17→65; other channels238/201 retained.
shading: PanelDHL alone uses0.3 raised-panel lettering bounce instead of0.6. Salesforce stays0.6; original89 native palette assets unchanged.

candidate14_color_study.qualification: Broad yellow-pixel mask over registered frontage region, not radiometry or identical camera pixels. Final native appearance remains a visual gate.

separator: Use the existing original PanelJeddahAramco texture with continuous longitudinal UVs. Estimated12m full green/blue cycle,6m per wordmark, plus/minus2m. Retain exact1.1m separator width,8mm lift,white edge and all underlying driving support.
